@MGraybosch What ever you heard isn't true. I live my life as a hyperbole. My morals are metaphors

BTW share with #writingcommunity , #clmooc giving out poems to those who need them or who want to give gift of poetry: https://clmooc.com/come-sail-into-the-poetry-port/
